title: SAM Resource Name Linter Rules
description: Schema for defining naming rules in the SAM Resource Name Linter

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editor validation.

rules.description: Naming rules keyed by CloudFormation or SAM resource type.

propertyName.description: Name of the resource property to validate (for example FunctionName or BucketName).

pattern.description: Regular expression the property value must match.

excludedWords.description: Substrings that must not appear in the name (matched case-insensitively).

maxLength.description: Maximum length of the property value.
